g.text: US-01: Entity Expiry - Stale Entity Removed from Map via Redis TTL and Client Staleness Timer
so evaluator scan always finds the key)
push { entity_id: XYZ123, lat, lon, last_seen_ms }
Feed returns no further pings for it.
No more position updates arrive for XYZ123.
Redis pub/sub publishes nothing - there is
no ping to forward. The API never pushes
the entity is faded and removed from the map.
No server push required for removal.
entity XYZ123 fades and is removed from map
Two separate cleanup mechanisms with different timings:
- Dashboard: removes marker when now() - last_seen_ms > SIGNAL_LOSS_THRESHOLD_MS (client-side timer)
- Redis: expires key after 24h (server-side safety-net to prevent permanent ghost keys)
These are NOT the same value. The Redis TTL is longer by design —
the key must still exist when the alert evaluator scans it (US-03).
Signal loss detection is driven by last_seen_ms, not TTL expiry.
